sentence: This project builds tools that use mass spectrometry to study how mitochondria change and interact inside human neurons.
This project uses experiments and modeling to find out how different parts of an enzyme's structure affect how well it works as a catalyst.
This project studies how an adversary can use machine learning to recover deleted information from flash memory.
This project tries to find out what causes variability among growing populations of T cells.
This project sets up a computing cluster that helps researchers study electronic cigarettes use among youth and mutations in the virus that causes COVID-19.
This project builds a control system for quantum computers that measures and corrects errors in many qubits in real time.
This project uses machine learning and network analysis on problems such as vehicular network security and soil moisture prediction.
This project studies how fruit flies choose their environment and how that choice shapes their development and evolution.
This project uses 3D printing to make graphene-metal aerogels that can remove and break down fluorinated organic chemicals from contaminated water.
This project builds tools that read bug reports and automatically reproduce bugs in Android apps.
This project combines optical and ultrasonic sensors to improve computer vision and robotic mapping.
This project tries to find out how plants sense carbon dioxide and use that signal to control the tiny pores in their leaves.
This project supports a program that helps research universities work with community partners to turn research into action.
This project develops processes that turn mixed plastics, food waste and agricultural waste into energy, chemicals and materials.
This project uses lab experiments and seismic data to find out how pressure beneath Antarctic glaciers changes across space and time.
This project combines mathematical methods to study how systems such as ecological invasion and fluid shock formation behave at large scales.
